question: Is Debrid-Link's total download cap 140 GB per day on the paid plan, and how does it relate to the per-host daySize values the API reports?
why: debridrank.com lists '140 GB/day download cap' for Debrid-Link; the record holds per-host daily byte and link counts and a 400 GB per day seedbox figure, and no account-wide daily cap. Needs the vendor page or an API limits reading.
